topics.title: Area under a curve using vertical strips

concepts.learning_objective: Explain the area under y = f(x) as the sum of thin vertical strips of area dA = y dx.
Calculate the area bounded by y = f(x), the x-axis and the ordinates x = a and x = b when f(x) is non-negative.
Calculate the area bounded by x = g(y), the y-axis and the lines y = c and y = d.
Decide whether vertical or horizontal strips describe a given region and set up the correct integral.

topics.title: Regions below the x-axis and curves crossing it

concepts.learning_objective: Take the absolute value of the definite integral when the curve lies below the x-axis.
Split the interval at the points where the curve crosses the x-axis and add the absolute areas of the parts.

topics.title: Areas of circles, ellipses and parabolic regions

concepts.learning_objective: Find the area enclosed by a circle x² + y² = a², or a quadrant of it, by integration.
Find the area enclosed by the ellipse x²/a² + y²/b² = 1 by integration.
Use the symmetry of a circle, ellipse or parabola to reduce an area to one quadrant and multiply.
